sentences.en: It was a high production dog dream. They even had catering.
sentences.zh: 这是一场高标准的狗梦。他们甚至提供了包办饮食。

sentences.en: I arranged catering for tomorrow's party.
sentences.zh: 我为明天的派对安排了餐饮服务。

sentences.en: You're catering to his every whim.
sentences.zh: 你简直是在迎合他的每一个愿望。

senses.zh: 迎合；满足需要；供应酒菜
